verdict.rationale: Metronome documents free trials and time-limited discounts, implemented as rate overrides on a customer's contract. Because the overrides are time-limited, billing at the normal rate after the trial is implied rather than explicitly documented as automatic conversion. Its webhooks cover contract, threshold and invoice events, but nothing ties them to trial-end notices or card-network rules, and promotion codes or coupons are absent. missing for 10: coupon/promotion-code redemption, explicit documented trial-to-paid conversion, trial-end customer notifications for card-network compliance, independent corroboration.
